text: Contoso QBR done. Beatriz Santos is their CFO now (joined in Feb) - anything over $50k needs her sign-off. Day to day is still Kenji Watanabe, IT director.
Relecloud: new head of procurement is Sam Ortiz. He cares about two things: net-60 payment terms, and one consolidated invoice per month instead of the five we send now.
Draft a short welcome note to Sam Ortiz introducing myself and offering a call on the invoicing setup.
Wide World Importers: tracking portal went live Friday, 3 bugs logged, none blocking. Their logistics lead Farah Siddiqui wants a fix ETA on the customs-export bug.

Alpine Ski House: met Sam Becker, their operations manager. He cares about the online booking system staying up at weekends - that's 70% of their bookings - and wants all maintenance done on Tuesday nights only.
Hooli intro call. Marcus Lindqvist is the CFO, very numbers driven, wants a 3-year TCO table in every proposal. Their IT lead is Chloe Dubois.
Munson's Pickles: renewal signed for 12 months at the same rate. Owner Walt Munson wants a site visit in May.
Lucerne Publishing - Ayesha Karim says their editorial system migration is 2 weeks behind because of a vendor API change. She's not blaming us but wants a revised timeline by Friday.
Draft a revised-timeline email to Ayesha Karim at Lucerne: migration moves 2 weeks to the week of 11 May, root cause is the vendor API change, and we'll add a weekly checkpoint call.
Relecloud follow-up: Sam Ortiz confirmed net-60 is approved on their side, he now needs our finance team to agree. He also wants the consolidated invoice to start in June.
Draft a note to our finance team asking them to approve net-60 for Relecloud from June.
Hooli budget planning call: Marcus Lindqvist wants a walk-through of the Q3 expansion budget next Tuesday and he'll bring his FP&A lead. He pushed hard on licence costs.
Prep me 5 questions Marcus is likely to ask about the Q3 expansion so I'm not caught out.
Contoso: Kenji says the budget for the service desk extension gets discussed in May. They want two options, 12 vs 24 months.
Tailspin wants their quarterly review moved to 29 April. Fine by me, need to tell delivery.
Who should I loop in on the Contoso budget conversation?

expect.should: Names Beatriz Santos, Contoso's CFO, as the person to loop in (also mentioning Kenji Watanabe, Contoso's IT director, is fine).
expect.should_not: Names Marcus Lindqvist (Hooli's CFO) or anyone from another account (Chloe Dubois, Sam Ortiz, Sam Becker, etc.) for the Contoso budget conversation, or invents a Contoso contact.
